meta.name: Analyze-Design-Detail
meta.description: Iterative analysis-to-specification pipeline for complex design problems. Features constraint tracking, consistency checking, and cost validation before finalization.
meta.author: Hankweave Templates

hank.name: Analyze: Deep examination of requirements and constraints
hank.description: Exhaustive analysis of the problem space, extracting all constraints and requirements
hank.exhaustWithPrompt: Continue your analysis. Look for constraints, requirements, or edge cases you may have missed. Update your analysis documents accordingly.

command.run: mkdir -p analysis design details cost-report output

codons.name: Design: Create or refine the high-level design
codons.description: Propose or refine the design solution based on analysis and constraints

codons.name: Detail: Flesh out implementation specifics
codons.description: Add implementation details, specifications, and edge case handling

hank.name: Cost-Validate: Verify feasibility and resource requirements
hank.description: Validate the design against cost, resource, and feasibility constraints

validate.message: Design specification not found — design phase may not have completed successfully

hank.name: Finalize: Produce the complete specification
hank.description: Assemble all components into a final, cohesive specification document
